prompt_fragment: This asset is a background or texture. Prioritize atmosphere and surface coherence over a single isolated subject.
raw_description:
A cathedral stained-glass window pane. An adult emperor penguin mid-
stride, ice chains snapping apart around its flippers, arms raised
toward an aurora crown overhead. Rich cobalt-blue sky panels behind,
gold rays radiating outward. Lead-divided jewel-toned glass, ornate
borders. Symbol of sovereignty and breakaway freedom.
formatted_prompt:

COLOR: Deep cobalt-blue (#1E4A85) for sky panels behind the figure; hot-springs emerald (#2DB56B) in aurora crown arcs overhead; warm ochre-gold (#C18A63) for radiating light rays and chain fragment highlights; shelf light blue (#4A90C5) for ice-chain glass pieces; warm brown (#6B5548) in ornate Gothic border tracery; aged parchment (#F5EDD8) as the ambient light behind the glass

DETAILS: Thick black lead lines divide every panel; glass surface luminous as if backlit by cathedral light; ornate interlocking Gothic knotwork at all four border edges; adult anatomical proportions throughout — lean, tall, no cartoon rounding
